description: Saves the person's preferences: where alerts go (email, here in the chat, or both), how often a summary email comes, the main goal and the markets that matter. Use this when the person has answered the preference questions. Do not use for profile facts. Side effects: changes the account's own settings.

alerts.description: Where alerts go: email, ai (here, in this chat) or both. Example: "both"

goal.description: The main goal: found_correctly, fix_negative, recommended_by_ai or win_press. Example: "found_correctly"

markets.description: Markets that matter (country and language); how many are scanned depends on the plan. Example: [{"country": "PT", "language": "pt"}]

country.description: ISO country code, such as US or DE

language.description: ISO language code, such as en or de

summary.description: How often a summary email comes: weekly, monthly or off. Example: "monthly"

name: set_preferences
title: Set the preferences
